scope: Actual retained commander GLB skin vertex regression for ordinary locomotion adapter. CPU checks are not proof of normal-game WebGL appearance.

checks.name: ordinary locomotion drives the actual retained skin rather than merely changing the parent transform
left and right commands alter real leg placement with identical camera and root transforms
zero dt freezes actual skin matrices, pose phase and blend even when controls change
held combat settles without accumulating additive rotations and idle remains bounded
repeated reset restores the same actual Idle skin and does not compound old recoil or strafing
full Run, left/right side gait and maximum recoil remain inside the published camera envelope
